name: Venomole
notes: Venomole: a plump purple mole with a pink snout and big lime digging claws. Type POISON. Moves: Poison Sting (A), Acid (B) and Toxic (R). Walks at full speed: its move 1 (Poison Sting) reaches 1 tile, and the farther a monster's move 1 reaches, the slower it walks. It can be the player, and the 8 species that aren't picked live on the map.
title: VENOMOLE
